name: Wuhan functional area
limitations: Eight dimensions and31 subpillars reviewed at conditional/partial levels, not fully measured. PCS/GSS/ISR/RES/MED60, TEC80, OPT40; LON unresolved gives mathematical domain54-64 without a total centre or reliable exclusion bound. Actual mitigation and current legal/operational paths are read with harms, old and selected clinical observations, unfinished repairs, payer qualifications and residual constraints. FUA8989 is not all administrative Wuhan; reference intersections are not exact projects, treatment sites or complete resident coverage. Locality, time continuity, usually usable appropriate affordable care/provision and residual materiality assumptions are reversible. All9031 and newer competitors remain.

dimensions.rationale: Actual free cooling-site use and2026 safety-system maintenance, multi-round pumping and cleared recorded road flooding, emergency slope works and small vegetation-fire control support operating protection. Submerged roads, stalled vehicles, displaced hazard households and12 complex slopes with monitoring/funding still pending retain genuine weaknesses.34 new hazard points plus3 slope areas and20+7+12 categories are different unresolved source counts, not silently reconciled.
dimensions.assumption: Accept these scoped core protection and mitigation observations as reasonably representative of8989 ordinary residents, continuing to cutoff, with important tail weaknesses but no broader persistent important unmitigated necessary-living bottleneck. Actual important residual low-house flood/heat-affordability/geological constraints could40; strong actual protection and affordable alternatives80. Reject locality, continuity, ordinary reach or residual-impact assumptions to restore unknown.

dimensions.rationale: The2020 final organized-coercion case retains cumulative historical harm from2007, not2026new harm. The prosecutor2025 report records132 arrests approved and108 prosecutions, not convictions or independent victims. Actual civil-defense exercise participation and regional military activity remain separate from wartime full capacity or Wuhan attacks; recorded absence does not establish safety.
dimensions.assumption: Accept current usual-life and core-route impacts as relatively limited after reviewed enforcement, with governance and response normally usable despite historical victims, regional threats and common channels. Persistent important coercion, failed restitution or regional/strategic route disruption could40; broader low impact and actual alternatives80. Reject current-impact, scope, ordinary reach or continuity assumptions to restore unknown; old harm is not presumed absent or ongoing.

dimensions.rationale: Actual legal correction, assistance and recovered wages, resident-course restoration and368-household completed gas connection, cross-organization flood response and accident compensation support functioning delivery. The2025 factory installation accident killed3 with5000000yuan direct loss excluding fines; repeated missed controls, absent training and late discovery/report remain serious institutional counterevidence, without a verified final repair. Hotline satisfaction includes adjusted dissatisfied cases, not unfiltered resident opinion.
dimensions.assumption: Accept continuing normally reachable core remedies and services as reasonably applicable to ordinary8989citizens, with retained serious failures not establishing a wider persistent important unmitigated execution constraint after scoped mitigation. This does not establish that the elevator loophole was repaired or cancel3deaths with other achievements.40 remains materially defensible if that repeated blind spot or recovery/rights barriers still importantly constrain protection;80needs actual repair, reach and backup. Reject continuity/reach/residual materiality to restore unknown.

dimensions.rationale: Seven unique September2026district water records comprise3plant and4terminal samples; duplicated responsive tables are not14samples. Six rows omit permanganate-index measurements, so all reported compliant labels do not mean complete chemistry or allFUAhouseholds.2022rural31plants/29compliant remain older counterevidence. Actual food transactions/short price relief, operating power and completed line improvements support scoped delivery; external routes, end-service and household affordability remain.
dimensions.assumption: Accept these actual water, food, energy and scoped assistance paths as reasonably representative of ordinary8989necessary supply, normally usable and affordable continuing to cutoff. Residual end-service/prices/common sources are important weaknesses, without presently inferring wider persistent important unmet necessities after mitigation. Actual important unmet supply/common interruptions could40; effective affordable backup under pressure80. Reject locality, continuity, normal affordability or residual materiality to restore unknown.

dimensions.rationale: Original infection-management process and observed endpoint outcomes, multi-hospital selected prevalence surveys, long-running necessary dialysis and actual flood protection/continued hospital care establish scoped treatment and continuity paths.2018-2022eye data,2016/18/20single-day HAI surveys and a selected dialysis registry ending2025are not2026all-resident quality. Historical COVID closure and current residual infection/loss-to-follow-up remain. Current usual employee/resident legal payment paths, actual assistance and bedside settlement support access, not universal enrollment or full-bill coverage.
dimensions.assumption: Conditionally accept multiple scoped ordinary/specialist care and actual current continuity paths as representative, with appropriate usual necessary treatment, qualifications, timely referrals and ordinary affordability normally available through cutoff. Clinical practice/quality continuation from earlier selected observations and payer/resident applicability are explicit assumptions, not zero unmet need. Retained historical closure, infection, payment/eligibility and tails are weaknesses rather than evidenced wider important unrelieved necessary-care barriers under these assumptions. Actual important waiting, quality, net-payment or continuity constraints could40; broader current appropriate outcomes/affordable backup80. Reject any necessary clinical/resident/time/payment/residual-materiality connection to restore unknown; no perfect median bill or zero-failure prerequisite is added.

dimensions.rationale: Shared disease-specific randomized human evidence, Chinese approval and261-patient national SAIL observations establish scoped scientific/regulatory context, not Wuhan treatment counts. The original2024local-infusion link returned a captcha; secondary reporting/prescription does not become verified hospital administration. Formal2026Fuhankang inpatient and listed-drug terms and human-assisted claims are reviewed, but local actual current mode, ordinary enrollment/net costs and monitoring remain unconnected.
dimensions.assumption: No anchor while credible actual local administration and current normally eligible resident drug-mode/payment/appropriate-monitoring connections are unresolved. Unlisted antibodies do not imply no inpatient benefit or universal impossibility, and researcher channel failure is not negative transparency evidence. A supported usually affordable compliant delivered disease pathway could60; actual important residual access barriers after mitigation40; multiple mature accessible pathways80. Approved early-AD treatment is not healthy-person longevity or approval expanded by medium-AD research.

dimensions.rationale: Two institutions have actual transfer/cash or completed transaction paths, industry process/training/manufacturing connections, strong subscription/production context and actual resident training followed by work and delivered assistance.2025cash1266000yuan and completed5250000yuan trade are different receipt stages; dental100000yuan received is web-only and the buyer outsideWuhan. City industrial totals and multiple-campus actors are not all8989unique residents, production or output quality.
dimensions.assumption: Accept scoped institutional/industrial capabilities and actual resident use/assistance as representative of8989main production and ordinary diffusion, continuing to cutoff, with delivered support making residual finance/skills constraints not an important overall diffusion break. Higher capability means multiple producers, not every product instantly interchangeable/every household unconstrained. Important remaining funding/skills/absorption barriers could60; actual disconnected output/use40. Reject location, continuity, ordinary reach or residual-materiality assumptions to restore unknown. Cross-border continuity is reviewed underOPT, not duplicate TEC deduction.

dimensions.rationale: Actual airport/rail/road/metro use establishes physical channels; Tianhe approximate point is outside the old union, not inaccessible. Shared Chinese skilled-work pre-entry national-visa qualifications and current Hubei capital-transfer approval preserve lawful possibilities alongside prior permanent-status/deregistration/purpose requirements. A formal satellite emergency voice/text path can mitigate ground loss but requires compatible equipment/open sky and does not restore international internet data. The GFW paper has no Wuhan measurement point.
dimensions.assumption: Accept national2024TLS/SNI mechanism as applicable to ordinary8989key cross-border data connections through2026, and prior-status/purpose capital-transfer conditions as materially limiting ordinary initial-move resources despite lawful current-account/physical/emergency alternatives. This is an explicit cross-city/household/time assumption, not a local cloud number or missing-sample penalty. More actual affordable legal resources and key communication relief could60; effective alternatives/common-failure results80. Reject mechanism applicability, continuation, household relevance or residual materiality to restore unknown. USD50000is not an all-transfer ceiling; no basis for universal severe exit blockade.

researchPriority.rule: All9031 candidates sorted by descending qualifying core nonretracted article-ID directory associations then numeric efua_id; skip22 registered reviews only to sequence research. Not performance, output-quality score, eligibility or exclusion.

referenceBoundaryCheck.method: Checksum-validated full9031 GHS-FUA load; EPSG4326 to ESRI54009 always_xy point intersection.
referenceBoundaryCheck.meaning: Analyst approximate references only, not exact treatment/event/project coordinates, institution footprints, full jurisdictions or resident service coverage.

sharedLegalPath.meaning: Existing shared all1539CHN rule; normally pre-entry visa and substantive qualifications, not approved residence, work, median-resident affordability or OPT score.
